messages:
maria: FYI ran a small pairwise bench across A100 / H100 / L40S with the new kernel-fallback enabled. Putting raw notes here for async review.
aj: thanks — can you drop the config you used and the perf bits?
maria: config: 
```
model: redwood-v1-medium
seq_len: 2048
batch_sizes: [1,4,8]
kernel_fallback: enabled
quant: q4_0 for L40S only
warmup: 25 steps
```
Results (median latency ms, single-request):
```
A100: batch1 45ms, b4 60ms, b8 98ms
H100: batch1 39ms, b4 55ms, b8 87ms
L40S: batch1 52ms, b4 70ms, b8 110ms
```
maria: notes: H100 wins p50; A100 slightly worse at b1 but closer at b8. L40S shows ~15–20% penalty at b1 vs A100 for this model; quant reduced mem but added ~6–8ms at b4/b8.
tara: nice, did you capture p99 or tail spikes? sahil and I saw microbursts on H100 with older driver.
maria: p99s: A100 b8 210ms, H100 b8 190ms, L40S b8 260ms. tail correlated with NVLink contention on A100 test rack (we saw other tenants). I pinned instance during this run.
ken: can you paste the raw CSV or gsheet link so I can hook into the dashboard? bench-bot: uploaded artifact -> http://internal-bench/2245678910/artifacts (csv + flamegraphs)
aj: quick question: did you disable preemptible instances and set isolation to dedicated? Those affect tail.
maria: yes isolated nodes, dedicated tenancy. Also set scheduler: continuous-batching=off for these runs to mimic single-request latency.
sahil: re: kernel-fallback — any failed kernels or fallbacks logged? small regressions we saw last week were caused by a missed AVX path.
maria: only 2 fallback events on L40S during b8 warmup, but stable after warmup. logs: ```WARN kernel_fallback: nvptx_to_cpu_path triggered 2 times; stack: ...``` 
maria: next steps I propose: 1) run p99-focused sweep with realistic multiplexed traffic (mixed seq len). 2) run A100 rack with NVLink isolation off to reproduce tail. 3) try H100 with continuous-batching=on to see throughput/latency tradeoff. Thoughts?
tara: +1 for mixed seq sweep. Also add a quant-compare for H100 (fp16 vs int8-ish profiles) if possible.
aj: I'll take action item 1 (mixed seq sweep) and try to reproduce tails on A100 rack. ken can you own the dashboard wiring? ken: yup will hook CSV into perf dashboard and add an overlay for kernel_fallback events.
bench-bot: summary: run_id=2245678910, artifact=http://internal-bench/2245678910/artifacts, issues_detected=[nvlink-contention, kernel_fallback_on_L40S]
maria: sweet. tagging @aj @ken for followups. If anyone wants immediate access to instances I can share keys for the isolated bench pool. :eyes:
aj: grabbing keys now, will post results in a follow-up thread. :thumbsup:
